postgres.description: Read/inspect the pmo_tracker PostgreSQL database directly (schema, ad-hoc queries) — useful given the schema is spread across db/init.ts + index.ts's runMigrations() rather than one migration tool. Set DATABASE_MCP_URL in your own shell environment, e.g. postgresql://pmo_user:<password>@localhost:5432/pmo_tracker — do NOT hardcode credentials in this file or commit them. (The old root-level mcp.json hardcoded a real password and is already committed to git history — rotate that password and stop using that file.)

github.description: Read issues/PRs and open PRs against this repo from Claude Code, matching the PR workflow in .claude/rules/pr.md. Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your own shell environment — do not hardcode it here.
